runtime_blocker.confirmed_fact: The active runtime exposes agent spawn, wait, list, message, follow-up, and interrupt operations but no agent-close operation.
runtime_blocker.playbook_consequence: research-playbook Required Runtime mandates parent-level spawn, wait, and close tools and forbids a merged, serialized, reused-role, or completion-as-close fallback.
runtime_blocker.resume_condition: A parent runtime exposes an agent-close operation capable of producing lifecycle close evidence.

official_host_evidence.research_consequence: PreToolUse is a useful governed-path guardrail but cannot alone prove the requested complete pre-action enforcement boundary across every mechanical action class.
